title: receiveTypingIndicators: per-chat scope, not per-account or per-server
description: The flag lives on the Chat object, giving users per-conversation granularity. A user can suppress typing indicators in a high-traffic channel while keeping them in a direct chat with a close contact. An account-level or server-level setting would be too coarse and would force an all-or-nothing choice. The Chat-scoped placement also fits the rest of the notification preference model (muted, muteUntil are also per-chat), making the mental model consistent.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
